Atom feed

  1. Faster text unions: NeoSCAD's patches for clipper2-rust

    6 October 2026 · The NeoSCAD project clipper2 open-source performance

    NeoSCAD's 2D geometry runs on clipper2-rust, a pure-Rust port of Clipper2. Two small changes to its sweep make a union of 200 lines of text three times faster with identical output. Here is what they do, why they are safe, and how they landed upstream.

  2. Faster, cancellable booleans: NeoSCAD's patches for manifold-rust

    2 October 2026 · The NeoSCAD project manifold open-source performance

    NeoSCAD builds its geometry on manifold-rust, a pure-Rust port of the Manifold library. Along the way we patched it in a few places. Here is what each change does, what it is worth, and the pull requests that offer it back upstream.

  3. NeoSCAD and OpenSCAD: what's the same, and what NeoSCAD adds

    2 October 2026 · The NeoSCAD project agents features openscad

    NeoSCAD runs OpenSCAD's language and libraries unchanged. Here is what stays the same, what NeoSCAD adds (printability checks, measurements, a warm render server, an MCP server for AI agents, an in-browser editor) and where it still differs from OpenSCAD.
